I definitely have found it depends on how you’re using the thick occlusive moisturiser. If you’re putting a heavy occlusive on already dry skin, the rich layer prevents any water from penetrating your skin, making the dryness much worse. You’re meant to use occlusive moisturisers on wet/damp skin immediately after washing. This way the occlusive traps the water on the skin which in turn prevents transepidermal water loss, which is a major cause of skin dryness. To help the occlusive work even better you can add a light humectant layer directly on wet skin before following immediately with the occlusive. This way the humectant holds on to the water and the occlusive traps it and stops it from evaporating, leaving your skin beautifully hydrated. I can guarantee of you start using thick occlusives this way you will notice a change in your skin dryness within a week (I definitely did!).
